inlines.v: CARTHAGINIAN, adjective Pertaining to ancient Carthage, a celebrated city on the Northern Coast of Africa, about twelve miles from the modern Tunis. It was founded by the Phenicians, and destroyed by the Romans. CARTHAGINIAN, noun An inhabitant or native of Carthage.
